label: prop:cyclotomic-depth3-dimension-synthesis
title: Cyclotomic depth-3 dimension synthesis: $(K - 3)/2$ at every prime $K \geq 5$
html:
For prime K \geq 5, let \mathcal{V}_K \subseteq \mathcal{P}_3 / \mathcal{P}_2 be the \mathbb{Q}-vector space spanned by the depth-3 grouplikes at the \zeta_K-orbit modulo the \zeta(3)-line. The vector space dimension bounds unconditionally as:

  \dim_{\mathbb{Q}} \mathcal{V}_K
  \;=\;
  \frac{K - 3}{2}.

The Tate-rational imaginary parts contribute zero dimension. The real-part orbit sum absorbs one dimension into the \zeta(3)-line. The remaining real parts supply exactly (K-3)/2 dimensions. This isolation of the genuinely new elements does not rely on per-prime numerical guesses.
heading: Proposition
